2026-09-12: migrated to the unified v2 Fact model (to/from, no id, required annotations). Real oracle text (data/fin/fin_scryfall.json, collector_number 63): "Reveal the top five cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand. Then choose an opponent. They put one on the bottom of your library. Then you put one into your hand. Then they put one on the bottom of your library. Put the other into your hand. / Flashback {7}{U}{U}", Sorcery, {2}{U}{U}. 5 facts total (all source, sink stays empty — nothing on this card wants anything): the same 4-fact Flashback baseline shape from-father-to-son (fin/20) and dreams-of-laguna (fin/50) already established — self-cast (Hand) + self-to-Graveyard (608.2m) + self-cast via Flashback (Graveyard) + self-to-Exile (thenExile) — mirrored exactly, INCLUDING that this card's own printed oracle_text has no Flashback reminder-text parenthetical at all (checked: unlike fin/20/fin/50's own oracle_text, this printing's Flashback line is bare 'Flashback {7}{U}{U}', nothing else) — the flashback-cast and to-Exile facts both anchor to that same short line as a result (no way to distinguish a 'cast from graveyard' phrase from an 'exile it' phrase when neither exists in the real text), a real card-specific quirk, not an authoring mistake. Plus 1 real card-specific fact: `{from:'Library', to:'Hand', controller:'you', value:5}`, oracle-anchored to the whole reveal/take paragraph — the real net card-selection advantage (3 of the revealed 5 end up in hand, 2 to the bottom of the library) modeled as a single unconstrained Library->Hand zone SOURCE fact (no `types` constraint, since the effect takes whichever of the 5 come up, unlike Ashe/Cloud Midgar Mercenary's own TYPED digs).

Granular back-and-forth simplification (per task instruction, checked against the engine): this card's own real effect alternates who chooses (you take 1, opponent bottoms 1, you take 1, opponent bottoms 1, you take the last) — `card.ts`'s `dig` effect kind has no player-choice machinery anywhere (same limitation Ashe/Cloud Midgar Mercenary's own dig-based facts already accept), so `definition.ts` already modeled this as `dig(qty:5, take:3)`, which reproduces the exact same NET zone outcome (3 to hand, 2 to bottom) without tracking which player picked which card or the alternating order — unchanged by this migration, already correct going in. Documented here as a real, deliberate simplification, not silently absorbed.

Compute-weights.mjs gap (checked, not fixed this pass — real, out-of-scope, pool-wide risk): `scripts/compute-weights.mjs`'s `sourceMagnitude` has no branch for a bare zone-only (no `event`) SOURCE fact beyond a token-subject count — an untyped, non-self, multi-object zone fact like this one's Library->Hand fact falls to the flat `return 1` floor, silently understating the real net-3-cards advantage a 4-mana sorcery like this one provides (the same magnitude that would legitimately earn the 3+ bucket, value 5, for an event-shaped fact like `dies`/`putCounter`). Manually set `value:5` on this fact instead of running `compute-weights.mjs` against it (which would currently reset it to 1) — checked whether extending `sourceMagnitude` to count real repeated `moveTo`-to-the-same-zone trace lines would be a safe, scoped fix: it is NOT — grepped every trace.json pool-wide and found 10+ other real cards (cantankerous-keepers, dion-bahamut-s-dominant-bahamut-warden-of-light, elixir, elrond-moon-reader, fight-on, jill-shiva-s-dominant-shiva-warden-of-ice, joshua-phoenix-s-dominant-phoenix-warden-of-fire, qutrub-forayer, rydia-s-return, thranduil-sindarin-liege-silvan-rally) already have multiple real same-zone `moveTo` trace lines that a general fix would also start counting, silently reweighting them pool-wide with no review — flagged as a real, deliberately-deferred future compute-weights.mjs enhancement, not fixed here. Do not run an unscoped (or even `--slug=memories-returning`) `compute-weights.mjs` pass without addressing this first, or this fact's hand-set `value:5` will silently revert to `1`.

Scenarios: consolidated to ONE real engine-piloted `runEngineScenarios()` playthrough (cast from hand -> real dig(5,take:3) -> graveyard -> Flashback cast -> real dig(5,take:3) -> exile), mirroring from-father-to-son's/dreams-of-laguna's own established one-scenario-both-modes shape for a real Flashback card (replacing the old flat 2-scenario `harness.ts` `Scenario[]` pair). `libraryCount:9` (1 real pilot-setup draw + two real dig(qty:5) looks, each permanently removing 3 — 9-1-3=5 remains, exactly enough for the second dig's own qty:5 look; confirmed via the regenerated trace.json, both digs report `found:3`). Added 'memories-returning' to `scripts/annotation-coverage.mjs`'s `ANNOTATED_CARD_SLUGS` and ran `compute-annotations.mjs memories-returning` (5/5 facts annotated for real against the real oracle text/type line).

Verified: `verify-synergy.mjs memories-returning` -> 0 hard failures (only the same accepted `tapForMana`-unrecognized soft notes every other engine-piloted card with a real mana cost gets). Full-pool `verify-synergy.mjs` run alongside heavy CONCURRENT work by other live sessions (confirmed via `git status` — ~40 other cards under active edit at the same time, e.g. cargo-ship/zack-fair/the-wind-crystal/white-auracite): 9 pre-existing hard failures pool-wide, none on this card, none newly introduced by this migration (checked each by name). `vitest run functional-model`: 1 failure (`the-prima-vista`, unrelated — a different concurrent session's own in-progress annotation-authoring work, confirmed via git status showing its own untracked/modified files mid-edit), 237/238 otherwise passing; `annotation-coverage.test.ts` scoped to this repo state also shows only that same unrelated failure. `find-synergies.mjs` diff, isolated via `git stash` of just this card's own synergy.json (holding the rest of the concurrently-shifting pool constant across both runs, same technique dreams-of-laguna's own migration used): the pre-existing 13 real graveyard-presence matches (Cantankerous Keepers, Eden Seat of the Sanctum, Elixir, Emet-Selch Unsundered, Ignis Scientia, Magic Pot, Qutrub Forayer, Rydia's Return, Sorceress's Schemes, Summon: Esper Ramuh, The Emperor of Palamecia, Thranduil Sindarin Liege, Vanille Cheerful l'Cie) are unchanged in COUNT, only relabeled from 'graveyard presence' to 'moves to graveyard' (expected, same SOURCE-fact-is-a-movement-not-presence rename from-father-to-son's own migration already went through); 2 genuinely NEW real matches gained via the new Library->Hand fact: 'Memories Returning --[tutor]--> Nibelheim Aflame' and '--[tutor]--> The Water Crystal' (both have a real, generic, untyped `{zone:'Hand', controller:'you'}` sink — checked both cards' own synergy.json to confirm this is a real match, not a false positive). Net: +2 lines (21594 -> 21596 in the isolated diff).
knownGaps: Granular back-and-forth (who picks which of the 5 cards, alternating you/opponent) is not separately modeled — dig(qty:5,take:3) reproduces only the net zone outcome, same accepted limitation as Ashe/Cloud Midgar Mercenary's own dig-based facts.
